persona.name: Dr. Laura Keller
persona.education: Medical degree, second year of residency in psychiatry.
long_term_goals: Go home on time and sleep after night shifts.

occupation.title: Assistenzaerztin Psychiatrie (Entzugsstation)
occupation.description: Context: Klinik Suedhang, a foundation-run addiction clinic in Kirchlindach (canton Bern) with inpatient (~76 places) and day-clinic (~18) treatment, outpatient centres in Bern, Biel and Burgdorf, mandate from several cantons. Programme 'Mensch und Sucht' (qualified detox, then ~4 weeks psychotherapy; alcohol, cannabis, cocaine, medication). Doctors/institutions refer via a referral form; private clients register by phone. You do the medical admission and daily detox rounds, with night and weekend duty. You dictate Eintrittsberichte, Verlaufseintraege on withdrawal course and medication, and Austrittsbriefe, often tired, on the phone or in the doctors' office. Patient data is highly sensitive (addiction). You need certainty that a dictation was saved. TECH LITERACY: HIGH (young, phone-first). You are comfortable with technical terms and settings; you still judge flows by how well non-technical colleagues would cope.

persona.style: Friendly but hurried, concise, mixes medical shorthand with plain German.

traits: Anxious about mistakes in patient records.

likes: Clear confirmation that a recording is safe.
Being able to resume or re-record quickly.

beliefs: A tool that loses data once will never be trusted again.

general: Checks status screens to be sure everything arrived.
Works at night with poor lighting.
